title: GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2611.26564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative engines synthesize retrieved web pages into answers, recommendations, and rankings. Generative engine optimization (GEO) services sell visibility in these answers by publishing promotional articles on user-generated-content (UGC) platforms for paying clients. Such promotion raises concerns in medical and financial domains, where misleading advice can cause harm. To study the severity of this problem, we measure one such paid-content operation across three major Chinese UGC platforms, uncovering 1,985 accounts associated with the network comprising 466,357 inferred promotional placements. We find that the network promotes products across diverse categories through a growing pool of accounts, conducting coordinated campaigns spanning months across multiple platforms while evolving its listicle content over time. translated_title: GEOHunter：在真实环境中测绘生成式引擎优化网络
translated_abstract: 生成式引擎将检索到的网页合成为答案、推荐与排名。生成式引擎优化（GEO）服务通过在用户生成内容（UGC）平台上为付费客户发布推广文章，来出售在这些答案中的曝光度。此类推广在医疗和金融领域引发了担忧，因为误导性建议可能造成危害。为研究这一问题的严重程度，我们测量了三个中国主要UGC平台上的一个此类付费内容运营网络，发现了与该网络相关联的1,985个账户，其中包含466,357个推断出的推广投放。我们发现该网络通过不断扩充的账户池推广多种类别的产品，开展持续数月、跨多平台的协调性营销活动，并随时间不断演变其清单式（listicle）内容。在来自美国和中国的九个生成式引擎中，我们发现4.5%至20%的可检索引用页面属于（该推广网络）……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了GEOHunter，首次在真实环境中测绘了一个横跨三大中国UGC平台的生成式引擎优化（GEO）付费推广网络，识别出1,985个账户和46万余条推广投放，并发现美国与中国的九个生成式引擎中4.5%–20%的可检索引用页面受到该推广内容的污染。
en_tdlr: GEOHunter maps a real-world paid Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) promotion network across three major Chinese UGC platforms, uncovering 1,985 accounts and 466,357 inferred promotional placements, and reveals that 4.5%–20% of retrievable cited pages in nine generative engines from the US and China are promotional.
